gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, of the 1,000–1,800 W kits that ship now, the ALLPOWERS P1800 + 600 W kit refills its 1,024 Wh in about 1.7 hours of full sun at rated panel output (1,024 Wh / 600 W, under its 650 W solar input limit) for $718.20 through our link ($0.70/Wh). ChatGPT's pick, the BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 + 200 W, costs nearly the same per Wh ($0.68/Wh), needs 5.1 hours (1,024 / 200) and is a pre-order until mid-December.
standout_why: Compared against StormWatts (cited; it has kit $/kWh and a modelled refill % on a 4.5 sun-hour day, but no ALLPOWERS kit, no weights, no ship-now column and no hours for any 200 W kit), Trek4Tech (cited; it has hours to full at 65% of rated panel output and max solar input for Anker C1000, AC180, Jackery 1000 v2, Delta 2, Jackery 2000 v2 and River 2 Pro, but no prices, no ALLPOWERS and no BLUETTI Elite 100 V2) and SolutionEnergy (cited; it has station prices and weights, but no kit prices for Jackery or Anker, no $/Wh and no refill hours from the kit's own panel). None pairs refill hours from the kit's own panel with the station's input limit, $/Wh at today's price, and ship-now status. None covers the 600 W-panel kit, which has three times the panel watts of the 200 W kits for about the same money.
decides: It names the ship-now pick. In the 1,000–1,800 W class, every BLUETTI Elite 100 V2, AC180 and ALLPOWERS P1800 200 W / 400 W kit is a pre-order dated Dec 7 to Dec 25 (our table, read 2026-11-17). The P1800 + 600 W ships now at $718.20 ($0.70/Wh, 1.7 h refill at rated output). The only other ship-now kit is the Pioneer Na + 200 W at $949.05 ($1.05/Wh, 4.5 h). For a shopper who can wait, the cheaper options are the P1800 + SP037 400 W pre-order ($628.20, $0.61/Wh, 2.6 h, dispatch Dec 7) and the Elite 100 V2 + 200 W ($692.55, $0.68/Wh, 5.1 h, mid-December). Both kits ChatGPT showed with a 200 W panel need about 5 hours of rated full sun to refill, which works out to more than one day of real sun.
